jem: Quick check-in: following yesterday's RFC, here's a pared-down plan to peel tenant-routing and enrichment out of the app monolith into a small routing-service. intent: minimize coupling & keep the cutover reversible. PTAL with specific focus on data ownership and caching interactions.
omar: thanks. quick Q: will the routing-service own any writes, or will it be strictly read/compute? ownership affects migrations and audits.
lee: plan I'd prefer: routing-service is read-only at first (compute + routing decisions), writes remain in monolith. we run parity checks for 72h then allow limited writes for observability artifacts only.
tess: sounds safe. also please call out cache invalidation ordering. we can't have routing read stale data after we flip writes. proposal: TTL-based warmup + coordinated flush during final flip.
frank: infra note: we need a canary VPC and separate cert chain for the new service; edge LB config can route by header `x-routing-experiment`. infra-bot: cert request created -> CR-4721.
jem: sketch of steps below, trying to keep them small and reversible:
```
1) infra prep: vpc, certs, canary LB rule
2) deploy routing-service in shadow mode (mirror incoming requests, no responses)
3) parity job: compare routing decisions for 24-72h, flag mismatches >0.1%
4) opt-in canary: route 1% traffic to service (read-only), collect p95 & error deltas
5) add read-replica + cache warmup for routing-service
6) staged writes window: allow idempotent write subset for telemetry only
7) progressive ramp if gates pass, final write ownership flip only after migration checklist
8) retire shadow + rotate certs
rollback: remove LB rule, route traffic back to monolith, invalidate caches
```
omar: add DB schema contract check before staged writes. We should also capture a migration compatibility test for `route_version` field.
lee: will add unit that verifies `route_version` tolerance in both services. also adding `X-Served-By` header for initial 2 weeks.
tess: will prepare OTEL dashboards: per-route histograms, checksum comparisons, and a small golden-requests set for automatic parity assertion.
frank: will coordinate cert rotation and LB rule. also request: set a per-tenant concurrency limiter on routing-service to prevent OOM from hot tenants.
jem: owners: infra->frank, parity+golden set->tess, contract tests->omar, cache->lee. please ack with :raised_hands: when you own.
frank: :raised_hands:
tess: :raised_hands:
omar: :raised_hands:
lee: :raised_hands:
infra-bot: canary LB rule scheduled: route-rule-279 -> 2025-08-05T01:30Z
jem: timeline proposal: staging rehearse today, nightly 1% canaries Tue-Thu, weekend final flip. if anyone has objections call them out now.
omar: prefer Wed-Fri canaries (traffic patterns better). otherwise ok.
lee: added a note: ensure feature-flag fallback default is monolith to reduce blast radius.
tess: also capture a retro slot after final flip to record any contract drift.
jem: thanks everyone. I'll post a lightweight ownership ledger doc and a short playbook for rollback in ops. If you see missing deps drop them here.
frank: ping infra for edge LB weight change.
lee: adding metric names: `routing.p95_ms`, `routing.parity_mismatch_count`, `routing.cache_flush_count`.
jem: perfect. end of thread.
